coordinator_summary: Exemplary call handling in a critical safety situation. Omar demonstrated exceptional judgment in recognizing the cardinal signs of acute coronary syndrome (chest pressure, dyspnea, dizziness), appropriately escalated to emergency services without delay, and provided clear actionable guidance (unlock door, sit down) while maintaining reassuring presence. Patient responded cooperatively and immediately initiated emergency care. This call exemplifies best practices in urgent medical triage—correct symptom recognition, zero hesitation on escalation, and supportive communication that enabled timely patient action. Privacy and documentation concerns are not applicable in this life-threat context; safety protocols were flawlessly executed.
